results.title: Ebola alert: Dr Agyemang calls for urgent assessment of isolation centres
results.content: The Member of Parliament (MP) for Abuakwa South, Dr Kingsley Agyemang, has called on the government to urgently assess the readiness of designated isolation and treatment facilities amid concerns over the spread of Ebola in West Africa.

results.title: Obuasi SHTS scandal will not fade from public attention – Education Minister
results.content: Education Minister Haruna Iddrisu has vowed that the sexual abuse allegations at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) will not be allowed to fade from public attention without a resolution. Speaking at a press conference in Accra on Monday, October 26, 2026, the Minister said the case would not follow the pattern of other major public controversies that attract intense media attention before gradually disappearing from the national conversation. “Amid the calls from various sections of society for a full-scale investigation of similar malpractices in other educational institutions in the country, this scandal won't suffer the same fate as other burning issues which are normal to be discussed with gusto in the media over a period and then go out with a whimper. That won't happen in respect of this matter,” he said.

results.title: Afreximbank records net income growth of 24% to US$813.5m; assets and contingencies exceed US$54.1bn
results.content: Commenting on the results, Denys Denya, Afreximbank's Senior Executive Vice President, said, “This performance underscores Afreximbank’s ability to deliver strong and sustainable performance while continuing to fulfil its development mandate across Africa and the Caribbean. Our expanded lending portfolio, robust profitability and strong capital position demonstrate the effectiveness of our strategy and the growing relevance of our interventions across our target markets. As global economic and geopolitical uncertainties persist, Afreximbank remains committed to providing the financing, trade facilitation and strategic investments needed to strengthen regional value chains, support industrialisation and accelerate the continent's economic transformation.”

results.title: Vodza Iron Breakers: You have given Keta a reason to stand tall
results.content: There are victories whose meaning travels far beyond the final whistle. They enter our homes, bring old friends together and give an entire community something to celebrate. Vodza Iron Breakers have given us such a victory. Their emphatic 4–1 win in the beach soccer final deserves a special tribute. To the players, technical team, management and supporters: you carried the name of Vodza with distinction and gave Keta a powerful reason to stand tall. A scoreline records the goals. It cannot fully capture the work that made them possible: the training, the corrections, the discipline and the willingness to keep pursuing a shared ambition. On the day that mattered, the Iron Breakers delivered.
